card.name: Linking words before storm and disaster terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (like, of, between, commas, as) that come right before a word for a storm or natural disaster such as hurricane, typhoon, cyclone, tropical storm or flooding. It appears in general web text about weather, climate and disasters.

modes.label: Lists of weather events
modes.description: A comma or similar mark inside a list of storms and disasters, just before the next one.

modes.label: Link into a disaster name
modes.description: A word like 'like', 'of' or 'between' that leads into a named storm or disaster.
modes.example: better the lives of those impacted by disasters<< like>> Hurricane Irene and Tropical Storm Lee.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward storm words such as typhoon, cyclone, flood and tropical.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a storm or flood term, when the text is about weather and disasters.
